record.source_closeout_reference: Thread-local sponsor-approved docs sync after reviewing recent commits and canonical docs; updated early read-order summaries to match rung-2 PASS and rung-3 unlock evidence.

mission.objective: Synchronize early canonical summary docs so they no longer say ladder rung 1 is active after rung 2 passed and rung 3 was unlocked; preserve advisory-only and NO PROMOTION YET boundaries.

envelope.reference: User approved step 1 after the canonical-doc review: update stale summary docs before rung-3 formation.

forbidden_scope: no runtime authority or governance routing
fallback_triggers: scope expansion beyond the authorized docs
advisory lint finding that cannot be resolved by wording-only sync
any wording that implies V3-OP-003 promotion or rung-3 execution approval

verification.summary: All scoped V3 advisory, operational-readiness, natural-language pilot, mission-record, knowledge-lint, and whitespace checks passed after the docs sync.

notes: The change is a bounded summary sync against already-recorded evidence, with no validator, profile, template, or runtime behavior changes.
All updated wording keeps V3-OP-003 at NO PROMOTION YET and names rung-3 formation as the next gate, not execution.
No halt or fallback trigger fired during the scoped doc sync.

friction_notes: Early read-order docs had drifted behind later pointer and ladder docs; this sync reduces cold-start confusion for future workers.
The change was cheap enough to record with a shadow mission record, matching Phase 2.5 optional-shadow-use guidance.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after closeout verification.

phase2_design_signals: Summary docs that sit early in the read order can become stale even when pointer registries and decision packs are correct; shadow records are useful for documenting why a purely editorial sync happened.
The most important wording boundary for this lane remains separating rung unlock and contract formation from execution or profile promotion.
